modernization_manifesto.Coding Standards: Target TypeScript/React for UI components and Java Spring Boot for backend services.
modernization_manifesto.Database Strategy: Replace VB6 ADO/DAO/RDO recordsets and embedded SQL with RESTful API endpoints and JPA/Hibernate repositories.
modernization_manifesto.Architecture: Decouple VB6 Forms, standard/class modules, global state, and COM/ActiveX (OCX) components into stateless, cloud-native microservices.
modernization_manifesto.Security: Enforce JWT-based authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for all newly generated API contracts.

target_architecture._note: OPTIONAL, source-language-independent target contract for Stage 6. Same schema for VB6/PowerBuilder/COBOL/future stacks — describes the NEW system only. Any field left blank is DECIDED by the generator from a grounded default (target_stack + modernization_manifesto + best practice) and recorded in the decision ledger — not raised as a blocking question. Values below are a worked example for this VB6 project's React + Spring Boot + PostgreSQL target; edit to match your standards.

system._note: Tier-B system/platform decisions (v2 spec). Monolith-first for autonomy: one deployable, schema-per-module ownership, in-process module calls, with a documented services-extraction seam.
system.data_ownership: schema-per-module (single PostgreSQL; no cross-module table access — calls go through module interfaces)

identity.rbac_source: legacy System Administration module (users, roles, permissions)

deployment.packaging: single Spring Boot container (one deployable) + static React bundle

data_migration.approach: one-time ETL from legacy DB to PostgreSQL with per-entity field mapping

observability.tracing: in-process (single deployable); add distributed tracing only if services are extracted

testing.acceptance_gate: app compiles, boots green, smoke + API/contract tests pass

layers.name: API
layers.responsibility: REST controllers, request/response DTOs, JWT/RBAC enforcement.

folder_structure.root: one Maven module (backend) + one Vite app (web) per microservice
mapping_rules: One microservice per bounded context (module) from module_manifest.
Shared/Infrastructure module -> a common library, not a service.
Feature code is placed by component_type folder rules above.

cross_cutting.approach: Spring Security with JWT bearer tokens; RBAC via method-level @PreAuthorize on controllers.
SLF4J + structured JSON logs; correlation id per request.
Spring profiles + externalized config; secrets from AWS Secrets Manager.

nfrs.architectural_response: stateless services, connection pooling, read models where needed.
multi-AZ ECS, health checks, graceful shutdown.

batch_strategy.scheduling: cron via scheduler (e.g. EventBridge) triggering batch jobs
batch_strategy._note: Light for this UI-centric VB6 system (a few batch modules); COBOL projects populate this more heavily. Same keys either way.

project.name: A Complete Inventory and Account Receivable System

llm._note: LLM provider configuration for the RIP pipeline. To switch providers, change 'active_provider' to one of: openai | anthropic | gemini | deepseek.

timeout_fallback._note: Timeout-ONLY escalation, GATED to non-streaming providers (deepseek). No effort/max_tokens rungs: DeepSeek has no effort knob and its 384K output must never be throttled. Anthropic uses streaming instead (see stream_providers) and is deliberately NOT listed here, so this ladder is dormant while Anthropic streams. Effective per-attempt timeouts 600/1200/1800/1800s.

circuit_breaker._note_consecutive: Counts CONSECUTIVE LLM TIMEOUTS only, and only in the SRS/spec and feature/user-story stages (resets to 0 on any success). Non-timeout failures and timeouts in other stages never trip it. 1 = exit as soon as one SRS/feature-story call exhausts its timeout attempts.
circuit_breaker._note_cost_disabled: Cost cap intentionally disabled (0) — larger projects can legitimately exceed a fixed dollar ceiling. The consecutive-failure and wall-clock triggers remain as the backstops.

llm._note_source_budget: Maximum combined character count for raw source files passed to the LLM per extraction call. Derived from 875K tokens * 4 chars/token (safe headroom within deepseek-v4-pro 1M context window). When exceeded, dependency files are noise-stripped (Tier 2) or replaced with [OMITTED] stubs (Tier 3). Primary entrypoint files are never subject to this limit.

gemini_3.5_flash.max_tokens_parameter: max_completion_tokens (extended-thinking path uses the completion-token ceiling)
gemini_3.5_flash.reasoning_level: Thinking controlled via 'thinking_level' (minimal|low|medium|high; default high). 'thinking_budget' is legacy/back-compat only. RIP passes litellm's unified 'reasoning_effort'=high (mapped to thinking_level=high). Do NOT set a non-default temperature on the reasoning path.

claude_sonnet_5.reasoning_level: Uses adaptive thinking via the 'effort' parameter (low|medium|high|max; default high). IMPORTANT: manual 'thinking' blocks and non-default sampling params (temperature/top_p) now return HTTP 400 — RIP must NOT send them on the reasoning path. RIP passes litellm's unified 'reasoning_effort'=high (mapped to effort=high). Native Anthropic caps at 200K input tokens; larger inputs require Gemini.

deepseek_v4_pro.context_window: 1M tokens (approx. 4M chars) — largest context among supported providers
deepseek_v4_pro.reasoning_level: Supports both non-thinking and thinking (default) modes. Thinking mode is the default; temperature is ignored by the provider in thinking mode. Use reasoning_keywords=[deepseek-v4-pro] to auto-route to max_completion_tokens path.

gemini._notes: Gemini 3.5 Flash MAX config: 1M-token input context, 65,536 max output tokens (the model ceiling). model==reasoning_model so every call runs Flash 3.5 in thinking mode (classified reasoning by exact-match, so no temperature is sent). reasoning_effort='high' is the DEEPEST thinking level Gemini offers (scale minimal|low|medium|high — there is NO 'max' level, unlike Anthropic/DeepSeek). large_context_input_threshold mirrors DeepSeek's ~1M-token headroom (~3.5M chars). event/batch_inline_max match the pipeline default (20/50); lower batch_inline_max if 65K-output batches truncate.

anthropic._notes: Claude Sonnet 5: 1M-token context window — this is the DEFAULT (NO beta header) and is billed at standard long-context pricing (per platform.claude.com/docs context-windows). 128,000 max output tokens. reasoning_effort='high' (adaptive-thinking scale low|medium|high|max; we use 'high', not 'max'). model==reasoning_model so every call is classified reasoning (exact-match) and NO temperature/top_p is sent — mandatory (Sonnet 5 returns HTTP 400 on non-default sampling params or manual 'thinking' blocks). TOKENIZER: Sonnet 5's tokenizer runs ~30% denser (~3 chars/token), so the 1M window holds ~3M chars. The top-level source_budget_chars (3.5M) is ~1.17M tokens at that ratio — marginally over 1M; for the very largest single payloads keep under ~3M chars, else the API stops with model_context_window_exceeded.

deepseek._supports_response_format_note: DeepSeek disabled the response_format request param API-side ('This response_format type is unavailable now'). Suppressed here; JSON reliability comes from prompt instructions + json_repair. Flip to true if/when DeepSeek restores support.
deepseek._notes: deepseek-v4-flash = standard/fast model (no reasoning). deepseek-v4-pro = reasoning/thinking model (1M context, 384K output). All pipeline calls default to the reasoning model (deepseek-v4-pro); use use_reasoning_model=False only where thinking overhead is undesirable.

stage2_5._note: Stage 2.5 module discovery. clustering_strategy: 'auto' = AI-primary semantic clustering with deterministic fallback (folder if unique_folders>=3, else lexical BFS); 'folder' = force one-module-per-folder and SKIP all Stage-2.5 LLM calls (budget + clustering); 'bfs' = force lexical leading-token grouping; 'ai' = force AI-primary (same as auto).

stage5._note: Stage 5 model is provider-agnostic: with 'model' null, Stage 5 uses LLMClient(use_reasoning_model=True), i.e. the active provider's reasoning model (deepseek-v4-pro / claude-sonnet-5 / gemini-3.5-flash). Set an explicit string here ONLY to pin Stage 5 to a specific model regardless of active_provider. focal_only_threshold: when SRS file count exceeds this, Stage 5a uses semi-deterministic extraction (Python linker + minimal LLM enrichment). Per-provider overrides via llm.providers.{name}.stage5_focal_only_threshold.
stage5._ui_bearing_srs_types_note: SRS document types that indicate a user-facing surface. MFUs whose focal SRS file resolves to one of these types are treated as functional (not infrastructure) by P2-guard and P10-guard. Add new types here when onboarding additional legacy stacks — e.g. JSPBlueprint, ASPXBlueprint, CobolScreenBlueprint. No code changes required.
stage5._functional_api_types_note: SRS document types for headless-but-functional modules (API services, business logic services with no UI screen). MFUs whose focal SRS resolves to one of these types are treated as functional (not infrastructure) by P10-guard. Distinct from ui_bearing_srs_types: use functional_api_types for modules that generate API-only stories (no React/UI tickets). Add new types (COBOLService, RPGServiceProgram) when onboarding additional stacks.
stage5._skip_module_ids_note: Module IDs to skip entirely during Stage 5. Shared/common modules contain only utility code with no independent business features. Supports exact IDs and fnmatch wildcards (e.g. 'MOD-SHARED*'). No downstream impact: Neo4j exporter handles missing features_stories.json gracefully.
